name: Robert D. Ravnaas
current_role: Chairman, CEO and Co-Founder, Kimbell Royalty Partners, LP (NYSE: KRP), Fort Worth, Texas
profile: Petroleum engineer who co-founded Kimbell Royalty Partners, an oil and gas mineral and royalty company that IPO'd on the NYSE in 2017. Before Kimbell he spent decades at petroleum engineering firm Cawley, Gillespie & Associates, becoming its president in 2011. He remains Chairman and CEO of Kimbell.
interesting_fact: With Brett Taylor he led the acquisition and management of over $1 billion of mineral and royalty assets between 1998 and 2015, before taking Kimbell public in 2017.
deep_cut_fact: Kimbell's roots trace to the Fort Worth Royalty Partners group he co-founded with Brett Taylor in 1999, anchored by the Kimbell Art Foundation (the museum's foundation). He began his career as an Amoco production engineer (1981-83) and graduated with special honors in chemical engineering from CU Boulder.
notes: Highly relevant for an energy podcast (minerals/royalties, Permian etc.). Low public profile; best route is Kimbell IR (Dennard Lascar) or company main office in Fort Worth.
